previous_statement: Choose the witness c0 for lem-maincb-error-improvement with c0 >= 1: enlarging any nonnegative witness to max{1,c0} preserves the result because lem-maincb-extended-inclusion-monotone upgrades each produced extended c0*epsilon-inclusion to the enlarged defect (and preserves bijectivity/isomorphism when present).
new_statement: Choose and retain the universal witness c0 supplied by lem-maincb-error-improvement. Nodes 1.1.1.1--1.1.1.2 prove that this same witness necessarily satisfies c0>=0. No enlargement of c0 is made, so c0 remains a witness for the full generality of lem-maincb-error-improvement; the constants used below absorb 1 separately.
